title: From Structural Feedback to Prompt Policies: Learning Faithful Text-to-Image Prompt Editors
abstract: arXiv:2610.36146v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prompt optimization should improve the image a user receives without changing the scene the user requested. Yet stylistic rewriting can weaken object attributes and relations even when global text--image similarity remains high. We propose StruPO, a structure-aware prompt editor that uses a calibrated scene graph as a shared representation for policy conditioning and image-grounded supervision. The graph exposes what should be preserved, while deletion, reordering, and insertion provide a token-aligned way to modify the prompt. This turns structural feedback from an external critique into a training signal for a reusable editing policy. Learning from that signal requires handling both uncertain grounding and stochastic image generation. StruPO retains grounding confidence through smooth reward shaping and averages multiple images for each edit before computing group-relative advantages. Experiments span three disjoint 2K-prompt test sets

translated_title: 从结构反馈到提示策略：学习忠实的文本到图像提示编辑器
translated_abstract: 提示优化应当在不改变用户所请求场景的前提下改善用户获得的图像。然而，即使全局文本-图像相似度保持较高水平，风格化的改写仍可能削弱物体属性及其相互关系。我们提出了StruPO，一种结构感知的提示编辑器，它使用校准后的场景图作为策略条件化和基于图像监督的共享表示。场景图揭示了应当保留的内容，而删除、重排和插入操作提供了一种与词元对齐的方式来修改提示。这将结构反馈从一种外部批评转变为可复用编辑策略的训练信号。从该信号中学习需要同时处理不确定的定位和随机的图像生成。StruPO通过平滑奖励塑形保留定位置信度，并在计算组相对优势之前对每次编辑生成的多个图像取平均。实验涵盖了三个互不重叠的2K提示测试集。
tldr: 该论文提出StruPO，一种结构感知的提示编辑器，利用校准场景图作为共享表示，并通过平滑奖励塑形和多图像平均处理定位不确定性与图像生成的随机性，从而学习忠实的文本到图像提示编辑策略，在不改变用户请求场景的前提下改善生成图像质量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes StruPO, a structure-aware prompt editor that leverages a calibrated scene graph as a shared representation, handling uncertain grounding and stochastic image generation through smooth reward shaping and multi-image averaging, to learn faithful text-to-image prompt editing policies that improve generated images without altering the user's requested scene.
